How the light works

The bright core casts real shadow maps. Small light sources on the inner faces approximate the first diffuse bounce, without tracing light paths or casting secondary shadows. The cool fill stays fixed in both modes. The Canvas 2D fallback analytically projects the shutters’ shadows onto the floor.
